rationale: Several papers contribute substantive new evidence on the Hubble constant and the reasons for conflicting results from different measurement methods. Papers [2307.02434] and [2401.13187] explore the impact of supernovae measurements, [2604.11106] and [2503.21600] investigate tensions in BAO and dark energy models, and [2406.02019] examines redshift evolution of the Hubble constant. However, the question remains unsettled.
